parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Media type of the request body. Set to `application/json`.

requestBody.description: Video generation V2 API. Input via multimodal content array (text / image / video / audio). Supports text-to-video, image-to-video (first/last frame), and multimodal reference-to-video with 2K output.

content.text: Character speaks: Follow the wind, live free. Leave worries behind, enjoy the moment, voice tone references audio 1

bearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

content.description:
Multimodal input content array describing the information used to generate the video. Each element is distinguished by type (text / image_url / video_url / audio_url) and can be annotated with a role.

Each request must contain a non-empty text item (prompt is required); omission will return a parameter error.
Supported input combinations (corresponding to different generation scenarios):

Text-to-video: a single text element only.

text.description: Text prompt. All scenarios require a non-empty text describing the expected video. Single text max 7000 characters.

image_url.description: Image object when type=image_url (format / size / dimension / count limits see content description above).

url.description: Image address. Supports: public URL; mm_file://{file_id} (reference platform existing files, such as uploaded or historical output file_id); data:image/<format>;base64,<Base64> data URI (<format> in lowercase).

video_url.description: Video object when type=video_url (reference video, multimodal reference scenario only; format / size / duration limits see content description above).

url.description: Video address. Supports: public URL; mm_file://{file_id} (reference platform existing file_id); data:video/mp4;base64,<Base64> data URI. Note: total request body size ≤ 64 MB, Base64 expands by ~33%, use public URL or mm_file:// for large videos.

audio_url.description: Audio object when type=audio_url (reference audio, multimodal reference scenario only; format / size / duration limits see content description above).

url.description: Audio address. Supports: public URL; mm_file://{file_id} (reference platform existing file_id); data:audio/<format>;base64,<Base64> data URI (<format> in lowercase).

role.description:
The position or purpose of the content, conditionally required:

first_frame: First frame image (image-to-video; if only one image is provided and role is not set, it defaults to first_frame).
last_frame: Last frame image (image-to-video first-last frame; must be paired with first_frame).
reference_image: Reference image (multimodal reference-to-video).
reference_video: Reference video (multimodal reference-to-video).
reference_audio: Reference audio (multimodal reference-to-video).
Video video_url (multimodal reference scenario only):

Item	Limit
Container / Format	MP4 (.mp4), MOV (.mov)
Encoding	Video H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC; Audio AAC, MP3
Single file size	≤ 50 MB
Count	≤ 3
Single segment duration	[2, 15] s; total duration ≤ 15 s
Width/height range	[256, 5760] px
Aspect ratio (width/height)	[0.4, 2.5]
Frame rate	[23.976, 60]
Audio audio_url (multimodal reference scenario only):

Item	Limit
Format	WAV, MP3
Single file size	≤ 15 MB
Count	≤ 3
Single segment duration	[2, 15] s; total duration ≤ 15 s

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Required, integer. Available: 4~15.

ratio.description:
Output video aspect ratio, default adaptive (automatically selects the most suitable aspect ratio based on input; the actual ratio can be retrieved from the ratio field in the query API).

Text-to-video (t2va, content contains only text): ratio is required and cannot be adaptive; available values: 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16.

callback_url.description:
Callback notification URL for task status changes. After configuration, the MiniMax server will first send a verification request containing a challenge field (must return the challenge value unchanged within 3 seconds to complete verification). Once verified, whenever the task status changes, a POST push will be sent to this URL, with the push body structure matching the query task API response.

Callback status values: queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled.

aigc_watermark.description: Whether to add an AIGC watermark to the generated video. Default false.

task_id.description: Task ID, used to query task status and results.
